name: Simple Zoom Out
description: The second clip zooms out into place from a close-up while it fades in over the first. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: zoom_quickness
params.description: Part of the transition spent zooming

params.name: fade
params.description: Fade the second clip in instead of cutting to it
